meta.name: Abhishek Abhigyanam
meta.tagline: Building full-stack products, enterprise workflows, and robust integrations with Python, MERN, and Odoo.

summary: Full Stack Software Engineer with experience shipping business-focused products across Odoo, MERN, and Python ecosystems. I enjoy turning complex workflows into clean interfaces, dependable APIs, and maintainable backend logic. My work spans payment integrations, planning tools, analytics-oriented dashboards, and customer-specific platform customizations for real production teams.

focusAreas.title: Enterprise Workflow Engineering
focusAreas.description: Design and extend internal tools, ERP modules, and operational interfaces that reduce manual work and fit naturally into real business processes.

focusAreas.title: Integrations and Platform Customization
focusAreas.description: Connect third-party services such as payment terminals and adapt products around client-specific rules, approvals, and domain requirements.

focusAreas.title: Full-Stack Product Delivery
focusAreas.description: Own features from UI composition to backend logic and data flow using React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB.

experience.summary: Own feature delivery across planning, payments, labeling, and customer-specific Odoo workflows, balancing product requirements with long-term maintainability.
experience.impact: Shipped modules used in production by active customers while improving debugging, performance, and day-to-day operator workflows.
highlights: Built Project Gantt Native and Manufacturing Gantt Native for Odoo; Project Gantt Native crossed 59+ sales on the Odoo App Store.
Implemented Stripe Payment Terminal and Linkly Payment Terminal integrations to enable seamless invoice payments inside Odoo.
Designed and delivered a ZPL Label Designer module with fully customizable label printing workflows.
Handled multiple client-specific customizations including notification sounds, advanced search capabilities, and Nafath verification during account creation.
Improved reliability and maintainability through debugging, refactoring, and performance profiling across live Odoo applications.

projects.title: FinanceGuard
projects.subtitle: Intelligent MERN Dashboard with Machine Learning
projects.description: A full-stack finance dashboard built on the MERN stack integrated with machine learning for financial predictions. Features real-time analytics, interactive data visualizations, and RESTful APIs for seamless frontend-backend communication.
projects.problem: Created to give users a single workspace for financial monitoring, trend analysis, and experimentation with predictive insights.
projects.impact: Demonstrates end-to-end ownership of dashboard UX, API integration, and data-driven product thinking.
highlights: Built REST-based data flows between React dashboards and Node/Express services.
Implemented reusable visual components for analytics, charts, and portfolio-style reporting views.
Structured the app to support machine learning predictions alongside core financial tracking features.

projects.title: Library Management System
projects.subtitle: Scalable MERN Web Application
projects.description: A scalable web application for managing library operations - book tracking, inventory control, and user management. Implements optimized MongoDB queries for large datasets and a clean React UI.
projects.problem: Designed to simplify catalog management, issue and return workflows, and role-based usage for a library environment.
projects.impact: Shows practical full-stack CRUD architecture, clean UI structuring, and backend separation across frontend and API repositories.
highlights: Built separate frontend and backend codebases for clearer responsibilities and deployment flexibility.
Modeled book, inventory, and user workflows with MongoDB-backed APIs.
Focused on usability and maintainability so everyday operations stay easy to manage.
